'''Salmon Dinner''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

Salmon Dinner may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. One Salmon Dinner may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].

==Tailoring==
Salmon Dinner is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt116.png|24px]] It can also be used as a red dye in the dye pots, located in [[Haley]]'s and [[Emily]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Salmon Dinner is not used in any [[quests]].
